info.name: PhonePe PG V2 Settlement
info.description:
PhonePe Payment Gateway V2 - Settlement & Split Settlement APIs.

Introduction: Settlement APIs let you reconcile the money PhonePe pays out to your bank account. Fetch the settlement IDs generated in a date range, check a settlement's status, and list the individual transactions that make up a settlement. Split Settlement lets you split a single payment across multiple linked accounts (marketplace / partner payouts).

Folders:
- Authorization -> Get Access Token
- Settlement -> Date Range Settlement IDs, Settlement Status, Settlement Transactions
- Split Settlement -> Get Split Account Info, Split Validation, Initiate Payment with SplitInfo, Order Status with SplitInfo
- Webhooks (Mock Server) -> settlement completed callback

Credentials: set client_id, client_version, client_secret and tsp_env in the environment; the access token is fetched/refreshed automatically.

Environments:
- Sandbox: https://api-preprod.phonepe.com/apis/pg-sandbox/<Endpoint>
- Production: Authorization API https://api.phonepe.com/apis/identity-manager/<Endpoint> ; Other APIs https://api.phonepe.com/apis/pg/<Endpoint>

API Endpoints:
- Authorization                     POST /v1/oauth/token
- Date Range Settlement IDs         GET  /settlements/v1/range?from&to&limit&offset
- Settlement Status                 GET  /settlements/v1/{settlementId}/status
- Settlement Transactions           GET  /settlements/v1/{settlementId}/transactions?limit&offset
- Get Split Account Info            GET  /settlements/v1/linked-accounts
- Split Validation                  POST /settlements/v1/split-settlement/validate
- Initiate Payment with SplitInfo   POST /checkout/v2/pay
- Order Status                      GET  /checkout/v2/order/{merchantOrderId}/status

Limits: Date-range 'limit' max 40, window not older than 6 months. Transactions 'limit' max 50, offsets must be strictly sequential.

Docs:
- Settlement (date range): https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/website-integration/standard-checkout/api-integration/api-reference/settlement/date-range-based-settlement
- Settlement Status: https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/website-integration/standard-checkout/api-integration/api-reference/settlement/settlement-status
- Settlement Transactions: https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/website-integration/standard-checkout/api-integration/api-reference/settlement/settlement-transactions
- Split Settlement (linked accounts): https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/website-integration/standard-checkout/api-integration/api-reference/split-settlement/get-split-account-info
- Split Validation: https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/website-integration/standard-checkout/api-integration/api-reference/split-settlement/split-validation
- Initiate Payment with SplitInfo: https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/website-integration/standard-checkout/api-integration/api-reference/split-settlement/initiate-payment-with-splitinfo

request.description: Check the status of a specific settlement by settlementId. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/website-integration/standard-checkout/api-integration/api-reference/settlement/settlement-status

List the individual transactions that make up a settlement. limit max 50; offsets must be strictly sequential when paginating. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/website-integration/standard-checkout/api-integration/api-reference/settlement/settlement-transactions

Fetch the sub-merchant / vendor accounts linked to your merchant that are eligible to receive split settlements. Use the returned accountIds in Split Validation and Initiate Payment with SplitInfo. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/website-integration/standard-checkout/api-integration/api-reference/split-settlement/get-split-account-info

Validate a split configuration before initiating a payment. The sum of accountsSplit values must reconcile with totalAmount (ABSOLUTE) or 100 (PERCENT). https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/website-integration/standard-checkout/api-integration/api-reference/split-settlement/split-validation

Create a Standard Checkout order that also carries split-settlement instructions. On success PhonePe returns a redirect URL and orderId. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/website-integration/standard-checkout/api-integration/api-reference/split-settlement/initiate-payment-with-splitinfo
